invariants.name: Second Confiteor omitted
invariants.assertion: E61 and Second-Confiteor runtime events are absent from the normative 1962 MC graph.

invariants.name: Bell semantics stay structured
invariants.assertion: No bell boolean exists; warning, elevation and Communion-warning events retain distinct purpose/legal status.

invariants.name: Public Gospel is canonical
invariants.assertion: The historical private celebrant Gospel is suppressed; the public Gospel owns the active Gospel sequence.

invariants.name: Old priest-DNSD bell is not Communion warning
invariants.assertion: The priest's Domine non sum dignus carries no Communion-warning bell; MC-COM-185 is the distinct conditional Solemn warning.

invariants.name: Consecration and Elevation are distinct
invariants.assertion: Words of Consecration and subsequent elevations keep separate MC identities and chronological anchors.

invariants.name: No actor propagation
invariants.assertion: Every event has explicit actor scope and participation may not infer a faithful action from priest/server/choir action.

invariants.name: Final rites remain ordered
invariants.assertion: Dismissal, Placeat, blessing and normal Last Gospel remain distinct and correctly ordered.

invariants.name: Only certified core forms enabled
invariants.assertion: LOW and SOLEMN are enabled; Missa Cantata and Requiem remain explicit unavailable research-gated forms.
